primary_estimand: Physical-activity (muscle contraction) contrast as the paper defines it: effect of 2-week unilateral hindlimb immobilization (disuse) on quadriceps transcriptome, immobilized right leg vs contralateral non-immobilized left leg of untreated caloric-restricted mice (S3.6.p1, FIG6A). Secondary: salbutamol effect in mobile vs immobilized legs (S3.6.p1-p2), and caloric restriction vs healthy reference (S3.6.p1). No exercise arm exists; disuse (removal of contraction) is the activity manipulation.
groups: 5 groups x n=15: H.0.0.R, CR.0.0.L, CR.I.0.R, CR.0.S.L, CR.I.S.R (S2.7.p1, FIG7)
repeated_measure_unit: mouse: CR mice contribute both legs (left non-immob, right immob) (S2.7.p1)
sample_inclusion: all 75 quadriceps samples (FIG7: n=15 per group)
planned_contrasts: CR+Immob untreated vs CR untreated non-immob (immobilization effect; paper 2241 genes, S3.6.p1)
CR untreated non-immob vs Healthy (caloric restriction; paper 6513 genes, S3.6.p1)
CR+Salbutamol non-immob vs CR untreated non-immob (salbutamol in mobile leg; paper 2904 genes, S3.6.p2)
CR+Immob+Salbutamol vs CR+Immob untreated (salbutamol in immobilized leg; paper count not stated directly; 281 overlap with IM genes, 518 overlap with 2904)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.11.p1 (DESeq2; pathways p < 0.01 only); S2.13.p1 general p < 0.05 for non-omics stats

paper_method: HTSeq-count -> DESeq2; GSEA on Reactome (pathway p < 0.01)
paper_results: IM 2241 DEGs; CR 6513; salbutamol non-immob 2904; 518 of those still significant in immobilized leg; muscle contraction pathway up by salbutamol in mobile leg only; Rac1 down in immobilized vs non-immobilized (log2FC -0.26)
